help_texts.active-hint: Active methods are offered at checkout, ordered by their position in this list.
help_texts.not-configured: Credentials are missing in the backend configuration; this method stays hidden at checkout until configured.
help_texts.not-registered: No driver is registered for this method in the backend, so it can no longer be used.
help_texts.refund-supported: Full or partial refunds can be issued right from this admin.
help_texts.refund-not-supported: No refund API is wired for this driver yet — refund in the gateway's dashboard.
help_texts.refund-crypto: Crypto payments cannot be reversed by the provider — any customer reimbursement must be arranged separately by the merchant.
